name: Quillon
description: A local-first note app powered by Smart RAG with command-driven workflows and intelligent tagging.

paragraphs: Quillon is a modern, lightweight, and intuitive note-taking application built with Vite, React, and TypeScript. Designed for speed and efficiency, it uses Smart RAG, Commands, and Intelligent Tags to capture, manage, and structure your notes effortlessly.
features: Query Expansion: Automatically expands messy queries (e.g., "mtg w/ sarah") into strict search terms ("meeting", "Sarah").
Oracle Reranking: Reads your notes like a human to find relevant content even in "Untitled" or messy files.
Context Chaining: Creates a dynamic "Knowledge Graph" by following links between notes.
Keyword Sniper: Instantly boosts exact Title matches for precision retrieval.
Reflection Core: The AI self-corrects and rewrites answers if they aren't perfect.
